incompleteness_irreducibility_decision.description: Formal decisions on the irreducibility of analyzed mathematical gaps.

decisions.basis: Aggregate CSI summation precludes unique causal reconstruction.
Preservation of degenerate branches is a core symmetry requirement.
Threshold information loss is inherent at the boundary; renormalizable for local proofs.
Finite stability results do not extend to infinite iterations without explicit asymptotic hypotheses.
Measure-theoretic formalization path identified; not an intrinsic structural limit.
